tasks.title: Author Terraform HCL Configuration
tasks.instructions: Create a file `main.tf` defining the `juju/juju` required provider and a `juju_model` resource named `lab_model` with `name = "tf-iac-lab"`.

tasks.title: Declare Application Resource in HCL
tasks.instructions: Add a `juju_application` resource named `frontend` into `main.tf` that deploys the `ubuntu` charm with 1 unit into the `lab_model`.

tasks.title: Provision Model and Application
tasks.instructions: Create the model `tf-iac-lab` and deploy `frontend` (`ubuntu` charm) to reflect the declared Terraform state.
hints: Run `juju add-model tf-iac-lab` and `juju deploy ubuntu frontend -m tf-iac-lab`.
tasks.solution: juju add-model tf-iac-lab && juju deploy ubuntu frontend -m tf-iac-lab
tasks.check: juju show-model tf-iac-lab >/dev/null 2>&1 && juju status -m tf-iac-lab --format yaml | grep -q 'frontend:'
